content: चीरम् [चि-क्रन् दीर्घश्च; <ls>Uṇ. 2. 26</ls>] .²1 A rag, a tattered cloth, a long stripe or garment; <ls>Ms. 6. 6</ls>; क्षौमं दुकूलमजिनं चीरं वल्कलमेव वा <ls>Bhāg. 7. 13. 39</ls>. .²2 A bark. .²3 A cloth or garment in general; दर्भचीरं निवस्याथ दण्डाजिनविभूषितः <ls>Mb. 3. 39. 23</ls>. .²4 A necklace of pearls consisting of four strings. .²5 A stripe, stroke, line. .²6 A manner of writing with strokes. .²7 Lead. .²8 A crest. .²9 The dress of a Buddhist priest.
